title: Thema 9 — Waar heb je die laptop gekocht?

questions.explanation: 'De bon' is the receipt you get at the till; keep it if you want to exchange something.

questions.prompt: Hoe zeg je 'I want my money back'?
questions.explanation: 'Geld terug' means 'money back'; you say this when you want a refund.
It is 'het pakket' (the parcel); 'pakket' is a het-woord.

questions.prompt: Waar {{1}} je die laptop gekocht? (kopen, perfect)
questions.explanation: In the present perfect with 'kopen' you use 'hebben': 'heb je ... gekocht'. The past participle 'gekocht' goes to the end.

questions.prompt: Deze schoenen {{1}} niet, ze zijn te klein. (passen)
questions.explanation: 'Schoenen' is plural, so the verb 'passen' stays in the plural form 'passen'.

questions.prompt: Ik wil deze trui {{1}}, want hij is te groot. (ruilen)
questions.explanation: After the modal verb 'wil', the main verb goes to the end in the infinitive: 'ruilen'.

questions.prompt: Tweedehands kleding is gebruikte kleding. Nieuw kost meer dan ________.
questions.explanation: 'Tweedehands' means second-hand: clothing that someone has already used.

questions.prompt: De laptop is na een week stuk. Hij is ________.
questions.explanation: 'Kapot' means broken; with a warranty ('garantie') you can have it repaired.
